actual_thesis: Production is a single completed-context breakout-near-boundary snapshot gated by minutes_since_open, spot, vwap, orb_high/orb_low; it does not encode prior breakout event, later retest event, hold event, or resume event as separate temporal stages.

authority_register.limitations: heuristic production owner, not approved thesis

authority_register.exact_formula: expanding typical-price VWAP proxy, TR, ATR 14, ATR short 5, ATR long 30, first-15 ORB
authority_register.limitations: research proxy, not exact live tick/option truth

design_ambiguities: Approved Level-1 temporal ORB retest contract absent; ORB duration and retest confirmation details require human approval if not already accepted elsewhere.

objective_defects.baseline: provisional thesis requires break -> retest same boundary -> hold -> resume causal stages
objective_defects.current_rule: candidate if current spot is on/just outside ORB boundary and aligned with VWAP inside minute window
objective_defects.difference: no stored breakout time, retest time, hold candle, or continuation candle
objective_defects.smallest_proposed_correction: add explicit causal stage identity inputs or rename strategy as snapshot breakout-near-boundary variant
objective_defects.why_changes_meaning: a snapshot near ORB can be labelled retest without proving a prior breakout and later retest sequence

reachability: The current snapshot gate is theoretically reachable; true temporal retest reachability cannot be assessed because stages are not represented.
variable_matrix_note: See production line citations in findings; all _pct consumer gates use FRACTION except range_width_pct in regime/profile uses PERCENTAGE_POINTS.
